reasons.plausibility: The proposed repeated oxide/tribo-layer fracture mechanism aligns with known tribological and corrosion phenomena for multi-phase alloys at elevated temperature.
reasons.testability: It includes explicit, well-defined tribo-corrosion experiments at multiple temperatures and a clear falsification criterion based on wear and electrochemical metrics.
reasons.usefulness: This comprehensive protocol and comparison framework provides a strong basis for investigating tribo-corrosion behavior of HEAs versus established alloys.
